Woh Soo-e-Lalazar Phirte Hain 🌹

Recited by: Owais Raza Qadri
Kalam: Ala Hazrat Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (Rahmatullahi Alaih), Hadaiq-e-Bakhshish
Original: Ashraf Echo Sound on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=8-0C3YfcrrM)
All rights belong to the reciter and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete naat on the original channel. 🤍

Woh soo-e-lalazar phirte hain, tere din ae bahaar phirte hain: our Aaqa, Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Alihi Wasallam), walks toward the garden, and spring itself is blessed.

Visuals: Pixabay (DesignwithRiyas, muhammadarhamamin77800, Natsu_444)

#naat #naatsharif #owaisrazaqadri #alahazrat #kalameraza #hadaiqebakhshish #madina #greendome #islamicreels #mehfilesama

Mera Piya Ghar Aaya 🌹

Performed by: Ustad Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan
Kalam: Hazrat Baba Bulleh Shah (Rahmatullahi Alaih)
Original: Oriental Star Agencies on YouTube (youtube.com/watch?v=e3g8hlyfg5E)
All rights belong to the artist and the original publisher. Shared with love and full credit, for the Mehfil. Listen to the complete qawwali on the original channel. 🤍

Ghariyali deyo nikaal ni, mera piya ghar aaya: send the timekeeper away, my Beloved has come home.

#qawwali #nfak #nusratfatehalikhan #bullehshah #merapiyagharaaya #sufi #sufiqawwali #kalam #mehfilesama
